questions.solution_html:

questions.question: Describe the pathogenesis and diagnostic criteria of rheumatic heart / . CO3]

questions.question: Explain the causes and types of acute renal failure. / Part D Essay
questions.solution_html:
• Causes
  •  Interruption of blood flow to the kidneys from severe injury or illness
  •  Kidney inflammation due to toxins, drugs, infections or reduced blood supply
  •  Obstruction in urinary tract
  •  Kidney stones
  •  Nephrosclerosis - (2.5 marks)
  • Types
  •  Prerenal
  •  Intra renal
  •  Post renal
  •  Initiation phase, oliguric phase, diuretic phase, recovery phase - (2.5 marks)
  • Essay
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain the pharmacological and non-pharmacological treatment of / . CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• diabetes mellitus
  • Introduction - (3 marks)
  • Non - Pharmacological treatement
  • Dietary management
  • Physical activity, Weight management, Blood sugar monitoring, Self monitoring, Stress and
  • sleep management - (4 marks)
  • Pharmacological treatement
  • Insuline therapy
  • Biguanides - eg metformin - increase insuline
  • Sulphonylureas - stimulate pancreatic insuline secreation
  • Meglitinides - stimulate rapid insuline secreation
  • Thiazolidinediones - improve insulin sensitivity in muscle and adipose tissue - (3 marks)
questions.final_answer: Thiazolidinediones - improve insulin sensitivity in muscle and adipose tissue
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain the types and aetiology of diabetes mellitus
questions.solution_html:
• Type 1 - juvenile onset diabetes or insulin dependent dm - autoimmune disease, acidosis is
  • common, destruction of insulin producing B - cells of pancreas,underweight.
  • Type 2 - non insulin dependent, adult onset insulin production is impaired acidosis is infrequent
  • usually overweight, insulin resistance - (5 marks)
  • Aetiology - genetics , environmental factors, immunological factors, high carbohydrates intake
  • high caffeine intake, low fiber diet, overweight, sedentary lifestyle, etc. - (5 marks)
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Outline in detail the causes, symptoms, complications, and dietary / . CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Outline in detail the causes, symptoms, complications, and dietary management of
  • chronic renal failure.
  • Introduction - (2 marks)
  • Causes - glomerulonephritis, family hystory, nephrosclerosis, kidney stones, diabetes mellitus
  • contineuos use of medications hypertension, unhealthy dietary habits, dehydration, sedentory
  • lifestyle, liver disease etc - (2 marks)

  • complications etc. - (2 marks)
  • Dietary management - adequate calorie, restricted protein, restricted sodium, restricted
  • potasium, restricted phosphorus, adeqate calsium, fluid restriction, use healthy fats, normal
  • carbohydrates, avoid excessive vitamin A - (2 marks)
